guide.a.fields_support_formatting: Listing descriptions, terms and conditions, homepage text, and contact page text all support Markdown formatting.
guide.a.what_formatting_can_i_use: Bold with **bold**, italic with *italic*, links with [text](https://...), and lists with - at the start of a line. See the Markdown cheat sheet for more options.
guide.q.how_does_the_visual_editor_work: How does the visual editor work?
guide.a.how_does_the_visual_editor_work: Markdown fields open in a visual editor with a toolbar for bold, italic, links, headings, bulleted and numbered lists, and quotes. You can also use Ctrl+B / Ctrl+I, or type markdown shortcuts — - starts a list, # a heading, > a quote, and [text](url) becomes a link — and they convert as you type. Everything is stored as plain Markdown. Click Edit markdown under the field to work on the raw text (useful for anything the toolbar doesn't cover), and Edit visually to switch back. A field whose existing text uses formatting the visual editor can't preserve (tables, for example) opens as raw Markdown so nothing is rewritten behind your back.
